metadata.description: 日本の業務環境向け 汎用オフィスツール(Excel/CSV・ビジネス文書・日付)マーケットプレイス

plugins.name: jp-office
plugins.description: Japanese office toolkit — Excel/CSV workbench (encoding/normalization/diff/pivot/chart), Japanese business documents (議事録/稟議書/メール敬語添削/スライド構成/翻訳), business email drafting/reply/scheduling (jp-mail), date utilities (祝日/営業日/和暦). General-purpose, no company-specific content.
